analysis.reason: 직전 2거래일 연속 관망 유지. analysis.reasonEn: Previous two trading days maintained a wait-and-see stance. RSI at 50.9 has settled in the neutral zone, and MACD histogram at 1778.2708 continues to improve. Volume ratio to 5-day average is 1.16, indicating normal levels. Weekly ADX at 36.5 shows a clear trend, but daily ADX at 19.8 has entered a non-trending phase. Current price of 108,330 KRW is consolidating between SMA20 at 102,448 KRW and SMA50 at 117,504 KRW. 52-week position at 59.9% is in the neutral range. Volatility measured by ATR is high at 6.90%. 4-hour RSI at 50.9 aligns with the daily chart, confirming multi-timeframe alignment. However, the daily ADX at 19.8 lacks conviction for a trend reversal. Further indicator confirmation is needed to determine a clear buy/sell direction.
